rawContent: Throughout this week we'll be sharing blogs from @KingsCollegeLon students who interned with us earlier this year. Today, Sonia Teanio, writes about why #MeToo was overlooked and ignored in her home country of Italy. https://t.co/FnMORvxpdg

In the last of our student blogs, Baotran Lim discusses how the radical #metoo movement had a big impact in conservative Vietnam, despite the country lacking  awareness and even a language to express sexual harassment. https://t.co/ZW5a5t7yiF

"How can we properly deal with sexual violence and harassment, when society is de facto promoting sexualisation and gender stereotypes?" Sonia Teanio on the lukewarm reception of #metoo in Italy https://t.co/FnMORvxpdg

"This means that not only is there a lack of understanding, but victims of sexual harassment simply do not have the right terms to describe what has happened to them." Baotrim Lim on the impact of #MeToo in Vietnam. https://t.co/ZW5a5t7yiF
